title: The atom-free spectral class yields an explicit conditional bare-energy and analytic-radius budget

spectral_budget.definitions: Set B_E=B_0+B_3/2 and B_a=B_0/2+B_3 from K1603; then int|a|<=B_a, ||a||_infinity<=B_E and int|a|^2<=B_E B_a.
spectral_budget.bare_energy: K1598 gives E_0(t)<=E_0(0)exp(2|e|B_a+(e^2/m)B_E B_a), closing the declared D' and M' expenditure.
spectral_budget.remainder: Let R(t)>=0 collect separately estimated curvature, oscillatory-Maxwell, current, radial and other hierarchy coefficients, with B_R=int R<infinity, and suppose the K1573 inequality has B_A(t)<=|e||a(t)|+R(t).
spectral_budget.positive_budget: The explicit sufficient condition (C_m/4)(|e|B_a+B_R)<rho_0 preserves a positive limiting analytic radius.
spectral_budget.scope_guard: This is conditional on the spectral representation, zero asymptotic holonomy, the declared integrable remainder and K1573 smooth-core hierarchy. It does not construct a nonlinear source-owned flow, quotient or Hamiltonian.
